feature: Migrate authentication from JWT to session-based auth

userStories.title: Replace JWT token generation with session creation
userStories.description: Replace the JWT signing logic in the login endpoint with express-session. On successful login, create a server-side session and set a secure httpOnly cookie instead of returning a JWT in the response body.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/auth/login creates a server-side session on success
Response sets a secure httpOnly cookie instead of returning a JWT
Session contains userId, email, and role fields
Existing tests in tests/auth/login.test.ts pass after modifications
No JWT imports remain in src/controllers/auth.ts

userStories.title: Replace JWT middleware with session middleware
userStories.description: Replace the JWT verification middleware with a session-based authentication middleware. The new middleware should check for a valid session cookie, load the session from the store, and attach user data to req.user.
acceptanceCriteria: Protected routes use session middleware instead of JWT middleware
req.user is populated from session data
401 returned when session is invalid or expired

userStories.title: Add logout endpoint that destroys session
userStories.description: Create a POST /api/auth/logout endpoint that destroys the server-side session and clears the session cookie from the client.
acceptanceCriteria: Subsequent requests with the old cookie return 401
Test in tests/auth/logout.test.ts covers happy path and edge cases

userStories.title: Remove all JWT dependencies
userStories.description: Remove jsonwebtoken from package.json, delete the JWT utility module, and ensure no file imports or references JWT-related code.
acceptanceCriteria: No remaining imports of jsonwebtoken or jwt utility
